keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Werder Bremen 0, Augsburg 1. Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Fabian Rieder following a fast break.
Arthur (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Augsburg. Yannik Keitel replaces Han-Noah Massengo.
Substitution, Augsburg. Rodrigo Ribeiro replaces Michael Gregoritsch.
Substitution, Augsburg. Alexis Claude-Maurice replaces Mert Kömür.
Delay in match because of an injury Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! Werder Bremen 0, Augsburg 2. Calvin Brackelmann (Augsburg) header from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Alexis Claude-Maurice with a cross following a corner.
Marco Grüll (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
